title: Anakin Skywalker
subtitle: Protect Her At All Costs
text: Action [Exhaust]: If 2 or more friendly units entered play this phase (including tokens and leaders), give a Shield token to 1 of them.
deployBox:
Sentinel (Enemy units in this arena must attack a Sentinel when they attack you.)
On Attack: Give a Shield token to another friendly unit that entered play this phase.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: Anakin’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if fewer than 2 friendly units entered play this phase (but no Shield token is created).
